payload.description: Deliver complete standard-library-only source implementing parse_records, format_records, to_json, and stdin/stdout/stderr CLI behavior. Acceptance expectations: require the exact header name,note; correctly handle quoted commas, doubled quotes, embedded newlines, CRLF, Unicode, and empty fields; raise ValueError for missing or wrong headers, malformed quoting, wrong column counts, and invalid record shapes, keys, or value types; serialize with the name,note header and LF line terminators while preserving strings; emit JSON that preserves original field strings, quoting semantics, newlines, and Unicode values; and provide CLI exit code 0 with only JSON on stdout for valid input, or exit code 2 with a useful stderr message, empty stdout, and no traceback for invalid input. The completed contribution must provide the entire csv_tool.py source as artifact.inline_text. Independent behavioral test design and final review are left to separate work items.
